name: Suan Sunandha Rajabhat University
description: A public university in Bangkok offering programmes across education, science and technology, humanities, management, and other professional fields.

name: Kasetsart University
description: A major public research university in Thailand, with a broad academic portfolio and a strong foundation in research, science, technology, and innovation.

name: Hallym University
description: A private university based in Chuncheon, Gangwon Province, with academic programmes and research spanning information science, engineering, health, social sciences, and the humanities.

name: Sejong University
description: A private university in Seoul with programmes and research across engineering, computing, business, arts, and the sciences.

name: Chung-Ang University
description: A comprehensive private university with its main Seoul campus in Heukseok-dong and a second campus in Anseong, covering disciplines including ICT engineering, software, business, medicine, and the arts.

name: Ho Chi Minh City Open University
description: A public university in Ho Chi Minh City with a mission in open and continuing education, alongside undergraduate, postgraduate, research, and community engagement activities.

name: Te Herenga Waka—Victoria University of Wellington
description: A public research university in Wellington, New Zealand, with teaching and research across humanities, social sciences, business, law, science, engineering, and creative disciplines.
